of.needed: whether users attempt to create applications with both name and server destination specified in the UI

consequence.statement: Users can now add applications through the UI when specifying both name and server destination, resolving the previous inability to create such applications.

assertion.statement: A bug fix in the Argo CD UI allows applications to be added when both name and server destination are specified, whereas this was previously unsupported.
